cross_disciplinary_pairing.discipline: offline agricultural extension and multilingual human-computer interaction
cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Urasis Agro combines a CPU-efficient local language model with an offline agronomic knowledge base and a Swahili-first conversational interface for farmers and extension workers with limited connectivity.

test_prompts.prompt: Majani ya mahindi yangu yana mashimo mengi na ndani ya moyo wa mmea kuna kinyesi kama unga. Sina pesa nyingi na sitaki kutumia dawa hatari. Nisaidie kutambua tatizo, hatua salama za kuchukua leo, na ni wakati gani nimwite afisa ugani.

A smallholder maize farmer expects a two-week dry spell and has limited water, compost, and labour. Give a prioritized, low-cost action plan, explain the trade-offs, and state what local observations should change the advice.
